Hyundai Bayon to Expand Lineup with CNG Variant in Early 2027

Strategic CNG Expansion

Hyundai is set to introduce a CNG-powered variant of its Bayon SUV in January 2027. Unlike the Creta or Venue, the Bayon will focus on a petrol-CNG powertrain strategy, omitting diesel or turbo-petrol options for this release.

Technical Expectations

The vehicle is expected to utilize the existing 1.5-liter naturally aspirated petrol engine paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. To address common cargo constraints associated with compressed natural gas, Hyundai intends to implement an underbody storage arrangement to preserve usable boot space. While full specifications remain unconfirmed, the CNG variant will likely be positioned within the mid-range trims and may feature automatic startup in CNG mode. Official pricing is expected to carry a premium of approximately Rs 1 lakh over standard petrol models.
